tasks.short: Research breeding of energy crops for biomass yield

steps.what: Open yield records for the energy crops
Conduct research to breed biomass and bioprocessing traits
Develop notes on resistance, efficiency, and environmental impacts

tasks.design: Yield and production records for the energy crops are opened from {DATA_PLATFORM}. The manager conducts the research to breed for biomass and bioprocessing characteristics, including adaptability, pest resistance, efficiency, and environmental impacts. Improved or reduced impact is the manager's judgement from the plots, not a score the system assigns.
tasks.previous_blocker: Plot yields were copied into a side sheet before a breeding decision.
tasks.enabler_now: The yield is stored on the plot, so the manager starts from the crop's own record.
tasks.still_hard: Breeding choices stay with the manager in the field and the lab.
tasks.human_edge: The manager decides which characteristics to pursue.
tasks.altitude: The manager sees the plot yields before a breeding decision.

reach.learn: Which crop and which trait were judged.

evidence.claim: Plot records can be opened, and breeding research stays with the manager. The source pack says a report is drafted from stored records and a person signs, and that a draft stops when a cited item is missing. Laboratory work and the scientific judgement stay with the person.

The source pack says hiring, evaluation, and monitoring of staff must not be decided by automation alone, and need consent where a works council has that right. This work does not score staff. A report or a proposal is signed by the manager before it goes out. Other countries differ.

assumptions: The work starts when energy crops are being bred and ends when the manager has written which traits to pursue.
A plot has plot id, crop id, and yield, entered from the field. The system does not rank a crop.
Time a system already spends running is not counted as the manager's effort.
A missing result, mass, or finding is not invented. The manager does that part.
The incremental hour updates the record when its source row changes.
unknowns: Which traits can be observed in this season.
research_questions: Which plots have yield recorded and no breeding note?

already_counted.description: The bench or review time is already in the manager's step.

incremental.description: Update the opened record when its source row changes.

time_saved_range_pct.basis: The saving is opening yields that are already recorded. Breeding, and the judgement of impact, stay with the manager.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

tasks.short: Develop computational tools for biofuels research

steps.what: Open inputs for the biofuels research activities
Run the computational tool on the stored inputs
Develop approaches where the tool did not improve the work

tasks.design: Inputs the manager defined for a research or development activity are opened from {DATA_PLATFORM}. The computational tool runs only those inputs and leaves a blank where an input is missing. The manager develops the approach and judges whether the run improved the work. The tool does not invent a scientific result.
tasks.previous_blocker: The same calculation was redone by hand when the inputs changed.
tasks.enabler_now: The inputs are stored, so a repeat run uses the same definition.
tasks.still_hard: Whether the tool is the right approach stays with the manager.
tasks.human_edge: The manager develops the tool's approach and reads the output.

ambition.what: A complete set of inputs can be run the day they are stored, and the manager still judges the output.

tasks.altitude: The manager sees the inputs beside the output.

evidence.claim: A stored calculation can be rerun on stored inputs, and the manager develops the approach. The source pack says a report is drafted from stored records and a person signs, and that a draft stops when a cited item is missing. Laboratory work and the scientific judgement stay with the person.

The source pack says hiring, evaluation, and monitoring of staff must not be decided by automation alone, and need consent where a works council has that right. This work does not score staff. A report or a proposal is signed by the manager before it goes out. Other countries differ.

assumptions: The work starts when a computational tool is used in the research and ends when the manager has judged the output.
An input has tool id, name, and value, entered by the manager. A missing value leaves that output blank.
Time a system already spends running is not counted as the manager's effort.
A missing result, mass, or finding is not invented. The manager does that part.
The incremental hour updates the record when its source row changes.
unknowns: Which calculations are stable enough to store as a tool.
research_questions: Which runs were blank because an input was missing?

already_counted.description: The bench or review time is already in the manager's step.

incremental.description: Update the opened record when its source row changes.

time_saved_range_pct.basis: The saving counts runs whose inputs are already stored. Developing the approach and judging the science stay with the manager.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

tasks.short: Develop separation processes to recover biofuels

steps.what: Open the biofuels stream and the separation brief
Develop separation processes to recover the biofuels
Note streams the separation did not recover

tasks.design: The stream and the separation brief are opened from {DOCS}. The manager develops the process that is meant to recover the biofuels. Streams that were not recovered stay noted. The brief does not choose the process.
tasks.previous_blocker: The brief and the bench process drifted apart.
tasks.enabler_now: The brief is stored on the stream, so development starts from it.
tasks.still_hard: Developing a separation that works stays with the manager.
tasks.altitude: The manager sees the stream brief before developing the separation.

evidence.claim: A brief can be opened, and developing the separation stays with the manager. The source pack says a report is drafted from stored records and a person signs, and that a draft stops when a cited item is missing. Laboratory work and the scientific judgement stay with the person.

The source pack says hiring, evaluation, and monitoring of staff must not be decided by automation alone, and need consent where a works council has that right. This work does not score staff. A report or a proposal is signed by the manager before it goes out. Other countries differ.

assumptions: The work starts when a biofuels stream needs a separation and ends when the manager has developed the process or noted the gap.
The brief has stream id and aim, written by the manager. The system does not add a process step.
Time a system already spends running is not counted as the manager's effort.
A missing result, mass, or finding is not invented. The manager does that part.
The incremental hour updates the record when its source row changes.
unknowns: Which separations this lab can trial.

already_counted.description: The bench or review time is already in the manager's step.

incremental.description: Update the opened record when its source row changes.

time_saved_range_pct.basis: The saving is opening a brief that already exists. Developing the separation stays with the manager.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

tasks.short: Design chemical conversion of fats and oils

steps.what: Open the vegetable oil refining brief
Note hydrogenation, oxidation, reduction, or etherification still open

tasks.design: The vegetable oil refining brief is opened from {DOCS}. The manager designs the chemical conversion, including esterification, transesterification, interesterification, distillation, hydrogenation, oxidation, or reduction. A reaction the manager did not design is not added.
tasks.previous_blocker: The conversion was sketched aside from the refining brief, so a step was easy to omit.
tasks.enabler_now: The brief names the feedstock and the aim, so the design starts there.
tasks.still_hard: Which reaction fits these fats and oils stays with the manager.
tasks.altitude: The manager sees the feedstock brief before designing a reaction.

evidence.claim: A refining brief can be opened, and the chemical design stays with the manager. The source pack says a report is drafted from stored records and a person signs, and that a draft stops when a cited item is missing. Laboratory work and the scientific judgement stay with the person.

The source pack says hiring, evaluation, and monitoring of staff must not be decided by automation alone, and need consent where a works council has that right. This work does not score staff. A report or a proposal is signed by the manager before it goes out. Other countries differ.

assumptions: The work starts when a conversion process is being designed and ends when the manager has designed it or noted the open reactions.
The brief has process id, feedstock, and aim, written by the manager. The system does not propose a reaction.
Time a system already spends running is not counted as the manager's effort.
A missing result, mass, or finding is not invented. The manager does that part.
The incremental hour updates the record when its source row changes.
unknowns: Which of these reactions the plant can actually run.
research_questions: Which named reactions are still undesigned?

already_counted.description: The bench or review time is already in the manager's step.

incremental.description: Update the opened record when its source row changes.

time_saved_range_pct.basis: The saving is opening a brief that already exists. Designing the conversion stays with the manager.
